resources.string: Lets the office operate the machine tablet remotely (tap and swipe) from the MV3D portal. Turn on once; everything else happens by itself.
No connection — the code appears as soon as there is internet.
One more tap: point out the folder
Type this code at the office: MV3D Convertor → Add a device.
No connection with mv3d.be right now — we keep trying.
Android may put this app to sleep
A site would then not come in overnight. One tap and that is solved.
The picker is already on the folder we expect. Press Use this folder.
This tablet will no longer be linked to its machine. The office will have to add the new code again in MV3D Convertor. Only do this if the tablet moves to another machine or company.
Got a code from the office? Type it in here
We do not know this code. Check it in the MV3D Convertor or on mv3d.be, under Machines.
The folder is no longer reachable. Point it out again.
The app is no longer allowed into the chosen folder. That happens after an update: tap \"Point out the folder\" and choose it again.
The server answers, but not correctly (%1$s). Try again later.
No connection to mv3d.be. The code could not be checked — try again once there is signal.
Send a site from this machine to another one. All you need are the eight digits from its screen.
Type the eight digits shown on the other machine’s screen.
On its way to %1$s. The two machines handle it; usually there within the minute.
%1$d of the %2$d files go along; %3$d stay on this machine.
